## Objective
- Build a complete browser-playable 3D open-world superhero game with city traversal, missions, villains, NPC interaction, drowning, menus, credits, and voice lines.

## Requirements
- Create an original 3D city, not copied from any existing Spider-Man game.
- Add super villains, voiced dialogue, villains including Venom, Sandman, Green Goblin, and additional villains.
- Add MJ.
- Add swinging and wall climbing.
- Make the city open world with cars and NPCs.
- Add NPC interaction.
- Include water where the hero can drown.
- Add missions, pause/main menus, credits, and a roughly two-hour campaign structure.
- Support desktop and mobile touch controls.

## Decisions
- Used a browser-based Three.js implementation with procedural geometry.
- Replaced the exact requested Spider-Man/Spider-Man 2 references with an original hero and original city while preserving the requested broad game archetype.
- Implemented the game as a single-screen 3D scene with HTML overlays and browser speech synthesis.
- Added a two-hour-scale mission progression as eight missions rather than timed full-duration content.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with main menu, pause menu, credits, HUD, mission UI, and touch controls.
- Created `style.css` with responsive desktop/mobile presentation.
- Created `game.js` with a Three.js 3D city, roads, buildings, waterfront, cars, NPCs, hero model, missions, boss targets, collision setup, camera, movement, water, drowning, dialogue, and menu logic.
- Added procedural 36-person civilian population and 18 moving cars.
- Added eight mission threads and eight mission locations.
- Added enemy target types for signals, rescues, and bosses.
- Added browser speech synthesis voice lines.
- Added desktop keyboard controls and mobile touch controls.
- Fixed an identified apostrophe syntax issue in a mission voice line.
- Syntax-checked `game.js` successfully.

### Active
- Current work is not yet extended with MJ, Venom, Sandman, Green Goblin, NPC dialogue/interactions, wall climbing, or the requested enhanced villain roster.

### Blocked
- No implementation blocker exists; the remaining enhancement work is unimplemented feature scope.

## Next Move
1. Open `game.js` and add named villain definitions for Venom, Sandman, Green Goblin, and others.
2. Add villain-specific models, attacks, voice lines, and boss mission entries.
3. Add an MJ NPC model and proximity interaction dialogue.
4. Add NPC interaction prompts and unique responses.
5. Add wall-climbing movement by detecting building collision surfaces and switching hero motion state.
6. Enhance swinging with attachment anchors and momentum-based camera/flight behavior.
7. Run a browser server, open the game, and capture and inspect a desktop screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Game markup, overlays, HUD, menus, mission UI, and touch controls.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css`: Full visual system and mobile layout.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: Three.js world, movement, missions, combat, NPCs, water, and game logic.

## Important Context
- `game.js` imports Three.js directly from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`.
- The game server can be run with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
